description.value: Papa Dave's Pizza Indian Cuisine is a local chain blending classic pizza with South Asian flavours — tandoori chicken, goat curry, biryanis, and gourmet pizzas share the same menu. The restaurant offers an all-you-can-eat pizza buffet and a full catering service, making it a stop suited to hungry group rides as well as solo cyclists. The business has operated for over two decades and pitches itself as a neighbourhood institution on the Fraser Highway corridor.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms Papa Dave's Pizza is a real, operating restaurant chain with pizza and Indian cuisine, offering dine-in, takeout, and delivery. The website lists two locations: New Westminster (820 20th St) and Fraser Hwy (Surrey), but the OSM coordinates (49.2257°N, 123.0778°W) place this pin in Vancouver/Burnaby, which does not correspond to either listed location — a significant geographic mismatch. The website confirms takeout and dine-in availability via the offers page ('Valid for dine-in, takeout, and delivery orders'), and vegetarian options are evident from menu items (veggie pasta, Indian dishes), but no bike-specific amenities are mentioned anywhere.
concerns: OSM coordinates (49.2257°N, 123.0778°W) place this pin in Vancouver/Burnaby, but the website lists only two locations: New Westminster (820 20th St) and Fraser Hwy, Surrey. The OSM pin does not correspond to either known location and may be misplaced or represent a former/phantom location.
OSM name is 'Papa Dave's Pizza Indian Cuisine'; the website consistently uses 'Papa Dave's Pizza' (without 'Indian Cuisine').
OSM has no address or phone; address and phone are sourced from the website's contact/footer pages and cannot be cross-checked against OSM.
Catering page lists a contact email of info@nonstoppizza.ca — a different domain than the website URL (papadavespizza.ca), which may indicate a shared platform or brand relationship worth verifying.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, operating restaurant confirmed by a live website with active menu, offers, and catering pages. Geographic pin mismatch is a data quality concern but does not affect inclusion.

wow_evidence: operated for over two decades ... two locations listed on website; geographic pin mismatch reduces confidence
